casino.interrupted_body: In the event of disconnection, a previously started round that has been interrupted may be resumed immediately by starting the game again. The results of a completed round (where display of the visual result was interrupted) will only be re-displayed within the game for winning rounds, but all game rounds may be reviewed in History. Any amount wagered on an unfinished game will remain paused until you either complete the game or the game is void as a result of account inactivity or system maintenance. When an unfinished game is void, your bet will be refunded to your account. Any awards earned on an unfinished round will not be credited unless you resume and complete the game. Winnings on unfinished game rounds where the player cannot further influence the outcome of the game will be automatically credited to the player's account after [[:period]]. Game rounds that require additional player input to determine the outcome of the game will remain unfinished for [[:period]], after which a default choice will automatically be made in order to complete the round and credit any winnings to the player's account. Game rounds will never be affected by unforeseen external errors due to hardware, bandwidth, network errors or similar. Game rounds will be either stored and completed by the player at a later time or they will be closed and the wager will be refunded to the player. If an incomplete game round has not been resumed within [[:rollbackAfter]], the round will be rolled back and the wager will be refunded.

casino.jackpot_body:
All Max Wins will be manually reviewed to ensure compliance with Hacksaw Gaming's terms and conditions as well as the terms and conditions of the operator. Any evidence of abuse or collusion will result in a loss of any Max Wins. All decisions are final.
After any Max Win Hacksaw Gaming reserves the right to request proof of age and perform checks in order to verify the identity and information provided by the account holder. These rules apply for the account holder:
- must not be under 18 years of age;
- must provide proof of address;
- must be a physical person (a legal entity will not be accepted);
- must not to be acting on behalf of another party;
- must not to be restricted by limited legal capacity.

The Max Win can not be won when playing in demo mode. Max Win winners will be contacted within 48 hours to verify the win.
casino.jackpot_won: Congratulations! You will be contacted within 48 hours to verify the win. All Max Win winnings will be manually reviewed to ensure compliance with current terms and conditions.

casino.win_body: Winnings and winning combinations are paid according to the paytable. Multiple wins in one round are added together and the total round win will be displayed in the WIN field (to the right of BALANCE). Separate wins in a winning combination will be displayed during the win presentation. Symbol payouts are displayed in the paytable and reflect the current bet configuration. Only the highest win per winning way is paid. Some win amounts may be displayed in an abbreviated format using letters to represent large numbers. When a win amount is displayed in this format, the displayed value may be rounded down. The actual amount awarded will never be less than the displayed value.

casino.winways_body_paylines: You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. casino.winways_body_ways: You win if matching symbols appear on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. Each winning combination of matching symbols creates a winning way. casino.winways_body_winning: The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

casino.about_desc_3: Step into the world of black and white, beneath the wicked grin lie coins aplenty. Just remember, Boney Bill has a few tricks up his sleeve. Come along for the max win of [[:maximumWinMultiplier]] times your bet in this 5-reel, 5-row game with All-Scatter wins. The max win is achievable in all game modes!
casino.expanding_desc: When a [[Wicked Grin]] or Epic [[Wicked Grin]] symbol is located on the bottom row, it will expand after all wins are handled. Expanded [[Wicked Grin]] and Epic [[Wicked Grin]] symbols will transform all symbols on that reel into Coins or a Multiplier.
casino.coins_desc: All Coins are paid as a multiple of your bet.
casino.bronze_coin_values: Bronze Coins have the following starting values: [[1x, 2x, 3x, 4x]]
casino.silver_coin_values: Silver Coins have the following starting values: [[5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x]]
casino.gold_coin_values: Gold Coins have the following starting values: [[10x, 20x, 30x, 40x, 50x]]
casino.diamond_coin_values: Diamond Coins have the following starting values: [[100x, 150x, 250x, 500x]]
casino.multiplier_values: Multipliers have the following values: [[x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20]]
casino.multiplier_desc: When a Multiplier is revealed, it will add a Multiplier value to all Coins above it and to Coins on the adjacent reels on rows above the Multiplier. If more than one Multiplier is revealed, they will add their values to the Coins one at a time from left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Multipliers cannot appear on the top row.
casino.epic_spread_desc: Expanded Epic [[Wicked Grin]] symbols trigger any type of [[Wicked Grin]] symbols on the grid to expand from the position they are in.
casino.epic_spread_desc_2: Only one type of [[Wicked Grin]] symbol can land on a reel at a time.
casino.fs_symbols_desc: When at least 1 [[FS]] or Super [[FS]] [[scatter]] symbol is located on the bottom row, each [[FS]] symbol expands across the entire reel it lands on after all wins have been awarded. Every position the [[FS]] and Super [[FS]] symbol covers represents a certain number of free spins. The total number of free spins awarded for the bonus is determined by adding up all the numbers on positions covered by each [[FS]] or Super [[FS]] symbol. [[FS]] and Super [[FS]] symbols can have the following values: [[1, 2, 3]].
casino.fs_symbols_desc_2: [[FS]] and Super [[FS]] cannot be on the grid at the same time. There can be a maximum of 2 [[FS]] and Super [[FS]] symbols on the grid at the same time.
casino.stash_n_stack_desc_1: Activate this bonus with 5-30 free spins by landing at least 1 expanding [[FS]] [[scatter]] symbol during the base game.
casino.stash_n_stack_desc_2: This bonus game keeps the base game’s mechanics. In addition, above each reel is a Stash with Multipliers starting at x1. When [[Wicked Grin]] symbols expand, all Coin values on that reel are multiplied by the Multiplier in the Stash. That Stash Multiplier will then increase by 1 for the next free spin.
casino.stash_n_stack_desc_3: Landing additional expanding [[FS]] symbols in the bonus awards extra free spins. Each expanding [[FS]] symbol awards at least 5 free spins and max 15 free spins. The total additional free spins awarded can be between 5-30.
casino.coin_craze_desc_1: Activate this bonus with 5-30 free spins by landing at least 1 expanding Super [[FS]] [[scatter]] symbol during the base game.
casino.coin_craze_desc_2: This bonus game keeps the base game’s mechanics. In addition, above each reel is a Coin Collector which starts at 1. When any [[Wicked Grin]] symbol expands, all Coin values on that reel are saved in the Coin Collector until the end of the bonus. When Multipliers are revealed during an expansion, the Multiplier affects the Coin values and multiplies the saved value in the Coin Collector on that reel and on the adjacent reels. At the end of the bonus, all Coin Collector values are added together and multiplied by the bet amount to determine the final awarded win.
casino.coin_craze_desc_3: Landing additional expanding Super [[FS]] symbols in the bonus awards extra free spins. Each expanding Super [[FS]] symbol awards at least 5 free spins and max 15 free spins. The total additional free spins awarded can be between 5-30.
casino.special_symbols_desc: [[FS]] and any type of [[Wicked Grin]] symbols cannot land on the grid at the same time.
casino.bonushunt_featurespins_desc: Each spin is 5 times more likely to trigger a bonus game!
casino.grinny_featurespins_desc: Each spin guarantees that at least 1 type of [[Wicked Grin]] symbol lands!
casino.stash_n_stack_desc: At least 5 free spins with a Stash above each reel that multiplies Coin values on that reel!
casino.coin_craze_desc: At least 5 free spins with a Coin Collector that saves all Coin values until the end!
casino.mod_feature_gameinfo_desc: The [[RTP]] when buying [[:bonus]] is [[:featurertp]]%. For full information about this feature, see the section above. [[FS]] symbols cannot land in this game mode.
casino.maxwingermany_body: Maximum win: [[:maximumWinMultiplier]] times the total stake. Probability of getting the maximum win: 1:[[:oddsofmaxwin]]. The maximum win occurs when [[5]] Epic Wicked Grin or Wicked Grin symbols land at the bottom of each reel, activating and transforming all symbols above into Coins, with a combined multiplier value of [[:maximumWinMultiplier]]x that is paid as a multiple of the bet. The maximum win is the sum of all winning combinations when the reels are stationary, taking into account further winning opportunities such as bonus rounds and free spins. The maximum win can be achieved in the base game but is only possible with a lower probability, if bonus rounds are excluded.
